test_camera_login_and_live_view.title: Verify camera web UI login and session - happy path

steps.action: Open the camera's web UI (http://<camera IP>/cgi-bin/index.cgi) and sign in with the lab login when the browser asks.
steps.expected: The main page loads with the Soterix Systems branding.
A timestamp overlay with today's date is shown on the video.

steps.action: Look at the live view controls.
steps.expected: The Full screen button is shown.

steps.action: Open the camera's web UI and sign in with a wrong username and password (admin / wrongpass).

steps.expected: No camera page content is shown, and there is no Setup button.
